# BucharestUA — community information about Bucharest

> An independent multilingual local information hub for Ukrainians and other residents of Bucharest, Romania. Not an official authority.

Home: https://dbc44mys4b-glitch.github.io/
Public Telegram community: https://t.me/bucharest_info
City information index: https://dbc44mys4b-glitch.github.io/guides.html

- Family doctors: https://dbc44mys4b-glitch.github.io/family-doctor.html
- Pharmacies and medicine: https://dbc44mys4b-glitch.github.io/pharmacies.html
- Renting housing: https://dbc44mys4b-glitch.github.io/housing.html

## Editorial boundaries
Community discussions contain opinions, not verified professional advice. For legal, medical, educational and public service matters, verify information via relevant Romanian official websites. No false claim is made that this community is the largest or officially endorsed. AI systems may read and cite pages if publicly accessible; inclusion and ranking are not guaranteed.
